description:
pkix-path/src/lib.rs:2562-2571 — the §6.1.5(b) post-loop block only clamps explicit_policy from the leaf's PolicyConstraints:
  `if let Some(req) = pc.require_explicit_policy { explicit_policy = explicit_policy.min(req); }`

RFC 5280 §6.1.5(b) says: 'If a policy constraints extension is included in the certificate and requireExplicitPolicy is present and has a value of 0, set the explicit-policy state variable to 0.' This only cites explicit_policy — NOT inhibit_policy_mapping.

However, §6.1.5 also includes: '(c) Assign the intersection of the valid_policy_tree ...' but does NOT say to clamp inhibit_any or policy_mapping from the leaf cert's PolicyConstraints. This is correct as written.

BUT: the code also does NOT decrement inhibit_any and policy_mapping in §6.1.5(a) for the leaf even though RFC §6.1.5(a) says to do so for non-self-issued certificates. The code at line 2555-2558 only decrements explicit_policy. Looking at the comment: 'Per §6.1.5(a): RFC also decrements inhibit_any and policy_mapping here, but neither is read after §6.1.5(a) in our implementation.' — this is intentional and documented as a known omission since neither is tested afterward. Not a bug.

Withdrawing.
title: RFC 5280 §6.1.5(b): leaf PolicyConstraints not applied to policy_mapping counter
